MIDI Keyboard Input

Hold a step to enter it, or arm recording and play.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Select channel; Record off; no step held; play MIDI keys	Audition the selected channel’s output without entering step masks.
Select channel → hold step → play MIDI keys	Enter that step’s note, velocity and chord masks.
Record (2,8) + running transport + MIDI keys	Record onto the selected channel’s active steps.

Norns Menu Navigation

Open tasks with E1; choose a row with E2 and change its value with E3.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
E1 → E2 → K3	Open the context task list, select a task, then open it.
E2 / E3	Select a row / change its value.
K3 / K2 on staged settings	Apply the draft / cancel or return. K3 also confirms a question and K2 cancels it. While an OPEN > row is chosen the last line names the target, for example K3 OPEN RHYTHM, or just K3 OPEN when space is short.
Hold K1 + E3	Change the selected value finely where it supports that.
Hold step + K2 in Masks	Clear all mask attributes of that step.

Channel Editor

Select one of 16 channels and open its editing tasks.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Grid (3,8)	Open the Channel Editor.
Tap a channel in grid row 1	Select one of 16 channels; the selected channel supplies the current masks, locks and range.
E1 → E2 task → K3	Open the named channel task; use the task list rather than an old screen-page shortcut.
Grid row 3	Read the currently active scale slot during playback.
Grid (8,8)–(12,8), no step held	Set the selected channel’s octave offset to −2, −1, 0, +1 or +2.
Press grid (10,8)	Set the selected channel’s octave offset to zero.

Adding Trig Masks

Add or remove a step trig mask with K1 and the sequencer grid.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel Editor: hold K1 and tap a sequencer step	Toggle the step’s trig mask; supply note, velocity and length masks if no source pattern supplies them.

Adding Melodic Notes over Harmony and Drums

Set channel mask defaults or step overrides for note, velocity, length and chord voices.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Masks → E2 attribute → E3	Set a channel default with no step held.
Hold a sequencer step → E2 attribute → E3	Set an explicit override for that step.
Hold a step and play a MIDI keyboard	Enter note-mask data from the played notes.

Adding Chords

Add up to four chord-mask voices to a root note. The selected output must support polyphony.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Masks → hold step → E2 Chd1–Chd4 → E3	Add up to four scale-relative chord voices to the root; the output must support them.
Assign Chord Strum or Chord Arp in Trig params	Space the chord voices in time rather than playing them simultaneously.

Removing Masks

Clear step-mask overrides without changing channel mask defaults.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Masks: hold step + K2	Clear all step-mask attributes for held steps; channel defaults remain.
Masks: K1 + K2 with no grid key held	Clear all step-mask overrides on the selected channel; preserve channel defaults.

Fully Quantise Mask

Set whether note masks follow scale degree and rotation, overriding global quantisation when explicitly Off or On.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Quantise Note Mask → K3 → K2	Assign Quantise Note Mask to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X, OFF or ON.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Locks

Store a different value on one step. Hold the step, then change the same control you use for the whole channel.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Hold a sequencer step, then change a value (E3 on Trig params or Masks, or a grid button for octave, scale and transposition).	The value is written to that step. The channel default does not change.
Release the step.	The screen shows the channel default again. The lock remains on the step.
Hold the step and press K2 on the screen where the lock was set.	The lock is removed and the step uses the channel default again.

Mask Locks

Give one step its own note, velocity, length or other mask value. Step locks override the channel default masks.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
On Channel tasks > Masks, select a mask with E2	The highlighted cell identifies the field to edit.
Hold a channel sequencer step and turn E3	Sets that mask for the held step instead of changing the channel default.
Hold the step and press K2 on Masks	Clears the held step’s mask locks so its channel defaults can apply again.
Release all steps, then hold K1 and press K2 on Masks	Clears channel step-mask locks while keeping channel default masks.

Quantiser Options

Set note-mask quantisation, channel scale-lock lifetime and pentatonic restrictions.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Open PARAMS > MOSAIC > Quantiser	Choose how masks, channel scale locks and pentatonic restrictions affect pitch.

Snap Note Masks to Scale

Snap note masks to the selected scale without degree or rotation changes. Default: On.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Select Snap note masks to scale. Change its value.	On snaps note masks to the selected scale without applying scale-degree or rotation adjustments; Quantise note masks overrides this setting. Default: On.

Quantise Note Masks

Fully quantise note masks, including scale-degree and transposition changes. Default: Off.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Open PARAMS > MOSAIC. Select Quantise note masks. Change its value.	On fully quantises note masks and applies scale-degree and transposition adjustments, overriding Snap note masks to scale. Default: Off.

Masks

Override channel and step trig, note, velocity, length and chord values.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Grid (3,8) → E1 tasks → E2 Masks → K3	Open the eight mask values.
E2	Choose Trig, Note, Vel, Len, Chd1–Chd4.
E3, no step held	Edit the channel default.
Hold step + E3	Edit that step's exception.
Hold K1 + tap step	Add or remove a trig mask.
Hold step + K2	Clear all mask attributes for the held step.
K1 + K2, no grid keys held	Clear channel step overrides; preserve defaults.

MIDI Controller Mapping

Assign MIDI controls to channel parameters through the norns MIDI Map menu.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Native PARAMS: hold K1 and press K3	Switch between EDIT and MAP modes.
Map editor: select Learn and press K3; operate MIDI control	Learn its CC, input channel and device.
Map editor: press K2	Leave the editor and save the assignment.
Operate assigned relative MIDI control	Change the mapped Mosaic value.

Norns Menu Navigation

Open tasks with E1; choose a row with E2 and change its value with E3.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
E1 → E2 → K3	Open the context task list, select a task, then open it.
E2 / E3	Select a row / change its value.
K3 / K2 on staged settings	Apply the draft / cancel or return. K3 also confirms a question and K2 cancels it. While an OPEN > row is chosen the last line names the target, for example K3 OPEN RHYTHM, or just K3 OPEN when space is short.
Hold K1 + E3	Change the selected value finely where it supports that.
Hold step + K2 in Masks	Clear all mask attributes of that step.

Rhythm Doctor

Select the fifth pattern algorithm at grid column 16, row 2 to capture, analyse and paint rhythm lanes.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
With the sequencer stopped, choose Rhythm Doctor at grid (16,2).	Open capture and paint. Recording, capture setup and Alignment require stopped transport; a finished bank can be browsed and painted while playing.
Empty bank: grid (1,2)	Start Record. Press again or use K3 after ENOUGH / REC OR K3 to finish.
Record before enough audio, or Record on an occupied bank	Open an abandon/clear question; K2 cancels and K3 confirms. Clearing a bank preserves already painted patterns.
Before capture: E2/E3 edit setup → K3 confirm; K2 cancels.	Record uses the confirmed setup. Stereo records both inputs separately; L duplicates the left input and R duplicates the right input into both recorded channels. Manual uses the selected integer BPM from recording start; Auto estimates tempo and phrase start.
Ready bank: select a lane, then E2 field → E3	Browse Window bar/step, sensitivity or paint policy.
In a locally analysed READY bank, press grid (3,2), (4,2) or (5,2).	Select BD (bass drum), SD (snare drum) or CYM (hi-hats and cymbals). The default local detector produces these three lanes; the remote server can declare additional lanes.
Ready bank: select Alignment → K3	Open the tempo, Start beat and fine-start draft. E2 chooses the field; E3 edits. K3 reanalyses the retained recording with the confirmed alignment; K2 cancels. Manual Start beat uses regular confirmed-tempo beats; Auto uses detected beats.
Grid (10,8) / (12,8); hold for a phrase	Move the recording window one step backward / forward, or a whole four-bar phrase.
Grid (11,8)	Return the window to its calculated phrase start.
Select destination pattern in row 1 → grid (16,8) twice	Preview the selected lane, then paint it; grid (14,8) cancels the preview.
If local analysis reports ANALYSIS_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.	No bank is created. See If local analysis fails for the norns setup needed to retry.

Removing Masks

Clear step-mask overrides without changing channel mask defaults.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Masks: hold step + K2	Clear all step-mask attributes for held steps; channel defaults remain.
Masks: K1 + K2 with no grid key held	Clear all step-mask overrides on the selected channel; preserve channel defaults.

Trig Parameters

Assign up to ten parameters per channel and set defaults or step locks for the current song pattern.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2	Choose one of ten parameter slots.
K2 → E3 parameter → K3 → K2	Open the assignment list, assign a parameter and return to the slot overview.
E3; hold K1 for fine adjustment	Change the selected slot’s default value.
Hold step + E3	Set an explicit step lock that overrides its channel default.
Hold step + K2	Clear held steps’ trig locks; K1 + K2 with no held grid key clears channel step locks.

Trig Probability

Set a trig’s playback probability from 0 to 100, globally or per step.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Trig Probability → K3 → K2	Assign Trig Probability to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: 0–100.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Fixed Note

Override ordinary root pitch with an unquantised MIDI note from 0 to 127.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Fixed Note → K3 → K2	Assign Fixed Note to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: MIDI 0–127; X disables the override.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Quantised Fixed Note

Set MIDI pitch 0–127 and select the nearest playable pitch in the active scale. Ties choose the lower pitch.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Quantised Fixed Note → K3 → K2	Assign Quantised Fixed Note to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: MIDI 0–127; X disables the override.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Random Note

Add a random scale-degree offset. Zero leaves the note unchanged.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Random Note → K3 → K2	Assign Random Note to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: 0 disables random displacement; positive values expand its scale-degree choices.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Random Twos Note

Add a random offset in multiples of two scale degrees. Zero leaves the note unchanged.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Twos Random Note → K3 → K2	Assign Twos Random Note to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: 0 disables displacement; positive values choose offsets in twos.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Strum

Play chord-mask slots once, spaced by the selected channel-step division.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Note Strum → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Note Strum to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X disables strumming; select a channel-step division.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Arpeggio

Repeat chord slots at the selected division for the note’s duration. Arpeggio takes precedence over Strum.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Note Arpeggio → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Note Arpeggio to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X disables arpeggiation; select a channel-step division.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Acceleration

Change successive Strum or Arpeggio gaps using Spread and Acceleration. Zero Spread disables the acceleration effect.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Accel Mod → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Accel Mod to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: −5 to +5; 0 is off.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Spread

Add a channel-step duration to Strum or Arpeggio spacing without changing note length.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Spread → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Spread to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X disables added spacing; select a channel-step duration.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Velocity Modifier

Adjust successive chord-note velocities by a positive or negative increment.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Velocity Mod → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Velocity Mod to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: −40 to +40; 0 leaves velocity unchanged.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Chord Shape Modifier

Set the slot order used by Chord Strum and Chord Arpeggio.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Chord Pattern → K3 → K2	Assign Chord Pattern to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X, ->, <-, -><- or <-->.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Mute Root Note

Silence the chord’s root slot while retaining its other chord voices.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Mute Chord Root → K3 → K2	Assign Mute Chord Root to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: OFF or ON.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Fully Quantise Mask

Set whether note masks follow scale degree and rotation, overriding global quantisation when explicitly Off or On.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Trig params → E2 slot → K2 → E3 Quantise Note Mask → K3 → K2	Assign Quantise Note Mask to one of the ten slots.
E3 with no grid step held	Edit the channel default: X, OFF or ON.
Hold a sequencer step + E3	Set that step’s parameter lock; clear it with held step + K2 to return to the channel default.

Scale Editor

Choose the scale the song plays in. Edit any of the 16 scale slots (Root, Scale, Degree, Transpose, Rotation) without changing playback until you apply it.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Press Grid (4, 8).	The Scale Editor opens. Scale slots are the 16 buttons on Grid row 3.
Short-press a scale slot on row 3.	Apply it globally and select it for editing. Press the applied slot again to turn global scale off while it stays selected for editing.
Hold K1 and press a scale slot, or long-press a different editing slot.	Select the slot for editing without changing which scale playback uses.
Long-press the slot already selected for editing.	Turn global scale off and clear the editing selection.
On the Scale screen, turn E2 to select Root, Scale, Degree, Transpose or Rotation. Turn E3 to change its value.	The value changes in the draft for the slot named in the title row. Nothing sounds different yet.
Release all grid keys, then press K3 or K2.	K3 applies the draft. K2 cancels it. Applying changes to a scale used by playback changes its harmony immediately.
On the Scale clock task, turn E2 to Rate and E3 to the rate, then press K3.	Set the rate of the global scale track. Selected range, Global cap and Playable range are shown for reference and cannot be edited there.
On the Scale page, hold the first step of a range on the scale track and press its last step.	Set the length of the scale track independently of the channels. The tooltip reads Channel 17 length changed.
Hold a sequencer step, then press a scale slot.	Set or toggle a scale lock at that step: global on the Scale page, channel-specific on a channel page.

Locks

Store a different value on one step. Hold the step, then change the same control you use for the whole channel.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Hold a sequencer step, then change a value (E3 on Trig params or Masks, or a grid button for octave, scale and transposition).	The value is written to that step. The channel default does not change.
Release the step.	The screen shows the channel default again. The lock remains on the step.
Hold the step and press K2 on the screen where the lock was set.	The lock is removed and the step uses the channel default again.

Trig Param Locks

Give one step its own value for an assigned device parameter, such as filter cutoff.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
On Channel tasks > Trig params, use E2 to select an assigned slot	The selected parameter cell is highlighted.
Hold a channel sequencer step and turn E3	Sets that assigned parameter for the held step; the cell shows its held value and L marker.
Hold the step and press K2 on Trig params	Clears parameter trig locks for the held step, rather than only the selected slot.
Release all steps, then hold K1 and press K2 on Trig params	Clears the channel parameter trig locks.

Mask Locks

Give one step its own note, velocity, length or other mask value. Step locks override the channel default masks.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
On Channel tasks > Masks, select a mask with E2	The highlighted cell identifies the field to edit.
Hold a channel sequencer step and turn E3	Sets that mask for the held step instead of changing the channel default.
Hold the step and press K2 on Masks	Clears the held step’s mask locks so its channel defaults can apply again.
Release all steps, then hold K1 and press K2 on Masks	Clears channel step-mask locks while keeping channel default masks.

Scale Locks

Change the scale on a step, for one channel or for every channel. A channel lock overrides the global scale.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Hold a channel sequencer step, then press a scale slot on Grid row 3.	Set a channel scale lock at that step. It overrides the global scale track. The norns screen shows Scale source.
On the Scale page, hold a scale-track step, then press a scale slot on Grid row 3.	Set a global scale lock. It lasts until a later global lock replaces it or the global scale track wraps. The norns screen shows Scale overview.
Hold the step and press its currently locked scale slot again.	Remove that scale lock.
Hold the step and press K2 in the relevant Scale or channel workspace.	Clear the locks on that step in that workspace. This clears the step; it does not undo one field.

Transposition Locks

Transpose the song from a chosen scale-track step. The lock is added to the selected scale's Transpose value.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Open the Scale grid workspace, hold a scale-track step and press a transposition value	Sets a transposition lock for that step; the global scale track supplies song transposition.
Hold that step and press the same transposition value again	Removes that lock, including an explicit zero lock.
Hold the scale-track step and press K2 in the Scale workspace	Clears the held scale-track locks.

Octave Locks

Place one step in a different octave from the channel's octave.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Hold a channel sequencer step and press an octave button on Grid row 8, columns 8–12.	Set the held step's octave lock to -2, -1, 0, +1 or +2.
Hold that step and press the same octave button again.	Remove the octave lock. An explicit 0 is a lock; no lock is different.
Hold the step and press K2 on Trig params.	Clear the step's trig locks, including its octave lock.

Harmony

Harmony provides Off, Revoice, Pattern and Ensemble modes for channel output pitch placement.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
In Channel tasks, select Harmony. Press K3.	Voice leading settings open.
Turn E2 to Mode. Turn E3.	The draft mode changes between Off, Revoice, Pattern and Ensemble.
Select Register or another settings row marked OPEN >. Press K3.	The selected settings list opens.
Turn E2 to select a value. Turn E3 to change it. Press K3 on a value row.	Mosaic validates and applies the draft. During playback, NEXT PATTERN indicates a queued change.
Press K2.	A dirty draft is cancelled. An opened settings list returns to its parent.
In Result, select Step.	The selected event’s planned and sent pitches are displayed.
On Note Dashboard, hold a grid step.	That step’s event is inspected. A step without a recorded event displays NO EVENT.
In Pattern mode, select Tone Map. Press K3. Select a Tone row and turn E3.	The row changes between RAW, BASS, INNER1, INNER2, INNER3 and TOP. K3 on a value row applies the map.
Select Register. Press K3. Select a role with the Role row, then select Low, High or Centre and turn E3.	The role’s inclusive MIDI range changes. A Low, High and Centre that leave no legal placement for a mapped note give NO VOICING RANGE and silence it.
Select Entry. Press K3. Select Failure fallback and turn E3.	Failure fallback changes between SILENCE and LEGACY. Silence is the default; Legacy plays the ordinary pitch and Result reads LEGACY RANGE.

Masks

Override channel and step trig, note, velocity, length and chord values.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Grid (3,8) → E1 tasks → E2 Masks → K3	Open the eight mask values.
E2	Choose Trig, Note, Vel, Len, Chd1–Chd4.
E3, no step held	Edit the channel default.
Hold step + E3	Edit that step's exception.
Hold K1 + tap step	Add or remove a trig mask.
Hold step + K2	Clear all mask attributes for the held step.
K1 + K2, no grid keys held	Clear channel step overrides; preserve defaults.

Set channel mask defaults or step overrides for note, velocity, length and chord voices.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Masks → E2 attribute → E3	Set a channel default with no step held.
Hold a sequencer step → E2 attribute → E3	Set an explicit override for that step.
Hold a step and play a MIDI keyboard	Enter note-mask data from the played notes.

Note Dashboard

Open Output to inspect the selected channel’s last note or a held step’s resolved output.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Channel tasks → Output	Inspect the selected channel’s last played note, degree, pitch and sent result.
Hold a sequencer step	Inspect that step’s resolved output, including Harmony stages.

Scale Editor

Choose the scale the song plays in. Edit any of the 16 scale slots (Root, Scale, Degree, Transpose, Rotation) without changing playback until you apply it.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Press Grid (4, 8).	The Scale Editor opens. Scale slots are the 16 buttons on Grid row 3.
Short-press a scale slot on row 3.	Apply it globally and select it for editing. Press the applied slot again to turn global scale off while it stays selected for editing.
Hold K1 and press a scale slot, or long-press a different editing slot.	Select the slot for editing without changing which scale playback uses.
Long-press the slot already selected for editing.	Turn global scale off and clear the editing selection.

On the Scale page, hold the first step of a range on the scale track and press its last step.	Set the length of the scale track independently of the channels. The tooltip reads Channel 17 length changed.
Hold a sequencer step, then press a scale slot.	Set or toggle a scale lock at that step: global on the Scale page, channel-specific on a channel page.

Musical Merge and Voice Leading

Foundation and Fragments reshape merged output without rewriting patterns. Harmony places output voices; its default is Off.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
In Channel tasks, turn E2 to Merge Shape or Harmony. Press K3.	The selected feature opens.
Turn E2.	The selected row changes.
Turn E3 on a value row.	The draft value changes.
Press K3 on a row marked OPEN >.	The selected settings list opens.
Press K3 on a value row.	Mosaic validates and applies the draft.
Press K2.	A dirty draft is discarded. In an opened settings list, the parent list returns.
Turn E1.	An unapplied draft is discarded and the feature’s first screen returns. From that screen, Channel tasks returns.

Structure

Structure moves selected Foundation notes to the nearest pitch class of an enabled Harmony group’s chord.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Choose Foundation on Merge modes or with grid (14,8). On Merge Shape, select Pitch and press K3, then select Structure and press K3.	The Structure list opens with Markers.
Select Markers. Turn E3.	Markers changes between OFF, ANCHORS, EVERY 4 and EVERY 8. When Markers is on, a Chord group row appears.
Select Chord group. Turn E3.	An enabled Harmony group becomes the draft chord source.
Press K3 on a value row.	The draft applies. A group that is missing or disabled prevents activation.

Harmony

Harmony provides Off, Revoice, Pattern and Ensemble modes for channel output pitch placement.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
In Channel tasks, select Harmony. Press K3.	Voice leading settings open.
Turn E2 to Mode. Turn E3.	The draft mode changes between Off, Revoice, Pattern and Ensemble.
Select Register or another settings row marked OPEN >. Press K3.	The selected settings list opens.
Turn E2 to select a value. Turn E3 to change it. Press K3 on a value row.	Mosaic validates and applies the draft. During playback, NEXT PATTERN indicates a queued change.
Press K2.	A dirty draft is cancelled. An opened settings list returns to its parent.
In Result, select Step.	The selected event’s planned and sent pitches are displayed.
On Note Dashboard, hold a grid step.	That step’s event is inspected. A step without a recorded event displays NO EVENT.
In Pattern mode, select Tone Map. Press K3. Select a Tone row and turn E3.	The row changes between RAW, BASS, INNER1, INNER2, INNER3 and TOP. K3 on a value row applies the map.
Select Register. Press K3. Select a role with the Role row, then select Low, High or Centre and turn E3.	The role’s inclusive MIDI range changes. A Low, High and Centre that leave no legal placement for a mapped note give NO VOICING RANGE and silence it.
Select Entry. Press K3. Select Failure fallback and turn E3.	Failure fallback changes between SILENCE and LEGACY. Silence is the default; Legacy plays the ordinary pitch and Result reads LEGACY RANGE.

Changing Harmony with Scale Slots

Compare the same relative patterns under C major for two bars and D major for two bars.

Adding Trigs

Enter pattern trigs manually or preview and paint a generated rhythm.

GESTURE	WHAT HAPPENS
Pattern Trig: tap row-1 pattern button	Choose the source pattern for editing.
Tap a sequencer step in grid rows 4–7	Toggle a trig; active trigs glow brightly.
Hold a trig and choose its end step	Set the note’s length; dimmer steps show its duration, cut short by another trig in the same pattern.
Tap algorithm button, columns 12–16 of row 2	Select Drum, Tresillo, Euclidean, Numeric Repetitor or Rhythm Doctor.
Tap Paint at grid (16,8), then tap it again	Preview the generated pattern, then commit it; flashing steps show the preview.
Tap Cancel at grid (14,8)	Discard the prepared preview.
Grid (10,8), (11,8), (12,8)	Move the preview left, reset its shift, or move it right; paint to commit.
